answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: that git fires post-merge on the land. Akienasus's land_one.sh lands with 'git merge -q --no-ff', and git runs post-merge after a successful non-squash merge. Second: that recompile_gate.sh with no env compiles the real lab from the repo it sits in. It does: it derives REPO from its own path and calls copy_to_lab with None roots. Third: the hook writes the lab into the commons tree and does not commit it. The lander commits it, as q148 did by hand.
answers.builder_check: A Haiku builder needs: (1) the hook file is cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/hooks/post-merge, bash, which reads 'git diff --name-only ORIG_HEAD HEAD' and pokes recompile_gate.sh (resolved through readlink -f of the repo's tracked copy) when any name ends in 'intention+why.json' or starts with 'intentions-not-beside-code/', and always exits 0; (2) recompile_gate.sh 'install <repo>' copies the hook into $(git -C <repo> rev-parse --git-common-dir)/hooks/post-merge, chmod +x, and is idempotent; with no args it still compiles as today; (3) the proof uses temp git repos, never the house trees, and points CAIRN_COMMONS_ROOT, CAIRN_CODE_ROOT, CAIRN_LAB_OUT and CAIRN_LOG_DIR at them; (4) PROVES keys '1','2','3'. The ticket carries all of these.

answers.collision_check: 'intentions-congruency-lab is derived, never authored' (CLAUDE.md IOU): recompile_gate.sh is the lab's legitimate derived writer, and the hook only pokes it, so this is no collision. The gate's charter says it is 'invoked by EVENTS only', and a merge is an event, so that is a distinction recorded. The tester's pre-commit hook (cairn/devices/tester/hooks/pre-commit) occupies a different hook name, so the two do not collide.
answers.falsifier_check: Proof cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/proofs/test_a_merge_recompiles_the_lab.py over a scratch cairn and CairnCommons pair with the hook installed by the install mode, CAIRN_LAB_OUT pointing at a scratch lab. Clause 1: merging a branch that changes a beside-code intention+why charter leaves the lab copy byte-equal to the merged source. Clause 2: merging a branch that changes no lab source leaves the lab's bytes and mtimes untouched. Clause 3: the install mode lays an executable post-merge into the repo's hooks dir, and a second install changes nothing. Red-first: at base there is no hook and no install mode, so all three are red. Horizon: no test_verify_on_the_real_repo red caused by a landed charter change.
answers.gates_bound: code-seam@v2's prove gate: the proof is sealed with its hollow build retaken; on failure it feeds back to TICKETME/FIXME (Laws 3 + 8).
answers.missing_check: A pull --rebase does not fire post-merge, so drift after a rebase pull is out of scope, and /intent's read-refresh stays its backstop. Installing the hook on every box is out of scope beyond the install mode; laying it on the fleet is the installer's. The reseal of test_compiler after a recompile is the lander's existing reseal step.
